rule_1_no_fake_lifecycle.description: Cannot simulate Activity lifecycle without DEX triggering it
rule_1_no_fake_lifecycle.enforcement: Halt if lifecycle method called without DEX origin
rule_1_no_fake_lifecycle.name: NO_FAKE_LIFECYCLE

rule_2_no_direct_cpp_activity.description: Cannot create Activity objects directly in C++ code
rule_2_no_direct_cpp_activity.enforcement: All objects must originate from new-instance opcode
rule_2_no_direct_cpp_activity.name: NO_DIRECT_CPP_ACTIVITY

rule_3_no_hardcoded_text.description: Cannot inject text into views without DEX setText call
rule_3_no_hardcoded_text.enforcement: Only setText from DEX can set view content
rule_3_no_hardcoded_text.name: NO_HARDCODED_TEXT_INJECTION

rule_4_all_api_from_dex.description: Every API call must originate from invoke-* opcode
rule_4_all_api_from_dex.enforcement: Track API call origin, reject non-DEX calls in strict mode
rule_4_all_api_from_dex.name: ALL_API_FROM_DEX
